name: ConCoction
blurb: Volunteer-run fan convention near Cleveland, Ohio for sci-fi, tabletop and video gaming, comics and cosplay, with charity fundraising.
notes: ConCoction 11 ('The Ragnarok of the Rings') ran March 6-8, 2026 at the Bertram Inn & Conference Center in Aurora, OH (the con brands itself 'Cleveland ConCoction' but its venue is actually in Aurora, a Cleveland-area suburb, per the venue's own address and 10times.com). The site is still showing the 2026 post-convention survey and has not posted 2027 dates; a convention recap blog (garydavidgillen.com) names a 2027 return themed 'A Star Noir' but gives no day-level dates, so no edition is recorded for the research window. Re-check clevelandconcoction.org for the 2027 date announcement.
